mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE((SELECT SUM(total_amount) FROM sales WHERE DATE(create_time) = CURDATE()), 0) AS todaySales, COALESCE(SUM(sd.count * (sd.price - COALESCE(g.purchase_price, 0))), 0) AS todayProfit, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sales WHERE DATE(create_time) = CURDATE()) AS todayOrders, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(loss_amount) FROM loss_report WHERE DATE(create_time) = CURDATE() AND status = 1), 0) AS todayLoss, COALESCE(SUM(sd.count * (sd.price - COALESCE(g.purchase_price, 0))), 0) - COALESCE((SELECT SUM(loss_amount) FROM loss_report WHERE DATE(create_time) = CURDATE() AND status = 1), 0) AS netProfit FROM sales s LEFT JOIN sales_detail sd ON s.id = sd.sales_id LEFT JOIN goods g ON sd.goods_id = g.id WHERE DATE(s.create_time) = CURDATE()

SELECT DATE(create_time) AS date, SUM(total_amount) AS totalAmount, COUNT(id) AS orderCount FROM sales WHERE create_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) GROUP BY DATE(create_time) ORDER BY date ASC

SELECT gt.name AS categoryName, SUM(sd.count) AS totalQuantity, SUM(sd.subtotal) AS totalAmount, ROUND(SUM(sd.subtotal) * 100.0 / ( SELECT SUM(subtotal) FROM sales_detail sd2 INNER JOIN sales s2 ON sd2.sales_id = s2.id WHERE s2.create_time >= #{startDate} AND s2.create_time < #{endDate} ), 2) AS ratio FROM sales_detail sd INNER JOIN sales s ON sd.sales_id = s.id INNER JOIN goods g ON sd.goods_id = g.id INNER JOIN goodstype gt ON g.goodsType = gt.id WHERE s.create_time >= #{startDate} AND s.create_time < #{endDate} GROUP BY gt.id, gt.name ORDER BY totalAmount DESC

SELECT DATE(s.create_time) AS date, SUM((sd.price - g.purchase_price) * sd.count) AS grossProfit FROM sales_detail sd INNER JOIN sales s ON sd.sales_id = s.id INNER JOIN goods g ON sd.goods_id = g.id WHERE s.create_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) GROUP BY DATE(s.create_time) ORDER BY date ASC

SELECT g.id AS goodsId, g.name AS goodsName, (g.count - COALESCE(g.reserved_count, 0)) AS currentStock, COALESCE(SUM(sd.count), 0) AS totalSales, CASE WHEN (g.count - COALESCE(g.reserved_count, 0)) > 0 THEN ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(sd.count), 0) * 100.0 / (g.count - COALESCE(g.reserved_count, 0)), 2) ELSE 0 END AS turnoverRate FROM goods g LEFT JOIN sales_detail sd ON g.id = sd.goods_id LEFT JOIN sales s ON sd.sales_id = s.id AND s.create_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 30 DAY) GROUP BY g.id, g.name, g.count, g.reserved_count HAVING totalSales > 0 ORDER BY turnoverRate DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT g.id AS goodsId, g.name AS goodsName, (g.count - COALESCE(g.reserved_count, 0)) AS currentStock, COALESCE(SUM(sd.count), 0) AS totalSales, CASE WHEN (g.count - COALESCE(g.reserved_count, 0)) > 0 THEN ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(sd.count), 0) * 100.0 / (g.count - COALESCE(g.reserved_count, 0)), 2) ELSE 0 END AS turnoverRate FROM goods g LEFT JOIN sales_detail sd ON g.id = sd.goods_id LEFT JOIN sales s ON sd.sales_id = s.id AND s.create_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 30 DAY) GROUP BY g.id, g.name, g.count, g.reserved_count HAVING totalSales > 0 ORDER BY turnoverRate ASC LIMIT 10

SELECT g.id AS goodsId, g.name AS goodsName, COALESCE(SUM(sd.count), 0) AS totalQuantity, COALESCE(SUM(sd.subtotal), 0) AS totalAmount, COALESCE(SUM(sd.count * (sd.price - COALESCE(g.purchase_price, 0))), 0) AS totalProfit FROM goods g LEFT JOIN sales_detail sd ON g.id = sd.goods_id LEFT JOIN sales s ON sd.sales_id = s.id AND s.create_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 30 DAY) GROUP BY g.id, g.name HAVING totalQuantity > 0 ORDER BY totalAmount DESC

SELECT g.id AS goodsId, g.name AS goodsName, g.barcode AS barcode, g.goodsType AS categoryId, gt.name AS categoryName, COALESCE(sales_stats.daily_avg_sales, 0) AS dailyAverageSales, g.count AS currentStock, CEIL( COALESCE(sales_stats.daily_avg_sales, 0) * #{cycleDays} + g.min_count - (g.count - COALESCE(g.reserved_count, 0)) ) AS suggestQuantity, g.min_count AS safetyStock, g.supplier_id AS supplierId, COALESCE(g.purchase_price, 0) AS purchasePrice FROM goods g LEFT JOIN goodstype gt ON g.goodsType = gt.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT sd.goods_id, SUM(sd.count) / 30.0 AS daily_avg_sales FROM sales_detail sd INNER JOIN sales s ON sd.sales_id = s.id WHERE s.create_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 30 DAY) GROUP BY sd.goods_id ) sales_stats ON g.id = sales_stats.goods_id WHERE ( COALESCE(sales_stats.daily_avg_sales, 0) * #{cycleDays} + g.min_count - (g.count - COALESCE(g.reserved_count, 0)) ) > 0 ORDER BY suggestQuantity DESC

SELECT id, name, storage, goodsType, count, reserved_count, min_count, barcode, specs, unit, retail_price, purchase_price, supplier_id, remark FROM goods WHERE (count - COALESCE(reserved_count, 0)) < min_count ORDER BY (count - COALESCE(reserved_count, 0)) ASC
